name: skills-test-harness
description: Plugins that ship with the skills-test-harness: eval-authoring skills that generate test scaffolds and eval suites for Claude Code skills and agents.

plugins.name: eval-authoring
plugins.description: Skills that author eval suites for the skills-test-harness. Home of build-skill-eval-scaffold and build-agent-eval-scaffold, which interview you and generate realistic project scaffolds for rubric (effectiveness) evaluation of a Claude Code skill or agent. Depends on nothing; run it from the harness repo where the target plugin:skill or plugin:agent lives.
